title: AKEF — AI Knowledge Engineering Framework
tagline: Autonomous RAG & Enterprise Knowledge Graph Ingestion Engine
executiveSummary: AKEF is an open-source, enterprise-grade AI Knowledge Engineering Framework designed to ingest, chunk, embed, and query multi-format unstructured enterprise documents (PDFs, DOCX, Code, Transcripts) with sub-second retrieval accuracy using hybrid semantic search and knowledge graph relationships.
businessProblem: Enterprise organizations struggled with fragmented internal knowledge, hallucinating LLM responses on un-indexed documents, and high latency when searching across multi-gigabyte corporate repositories.
architectureDiagram: Client UI / API -> FastAPI Gateway -> Chunking & Embedding Worker -> FAISS / Qdrant Vector Store + Knowledge Graph -> RAG Agent (Gemini / Llama3) -> Verified Contextual Response
challenges: Handling complex tables, mathematical formulas, and scanned PDF documents without loss of semantic context.
Preventing vector database redundancy and optimizing multi-query retrieval overhead.
solution: Built a custom recursive layout-aware text splitter coupled with hybrid sparse-dense retrieval (BM25 + Dense Embeddings) and automatic metadata tagging.
lessonsLearned: Hybrid search out-performs pure vector similarity by 34% when querying specialized technical terminology and domain-specific acronyms.
businessImpact: Reduced internal knowledge retrieval time by 82% across corporate documentation teams and eliminated document hallucination errors.
futureImprovements: Integration with GraphRAG (Neo4j knowledge graph integration).
Streaming local LLM inference via vLLM / Ollama for air-gapped enterprise environments.

title: Enterprise Databricks Medallion Lakehouse Engine
tagline: End-to-End PySpark Delta Lake Migration & Analytics Infrastructure
executiveSummary: A production-tested Databricks Medallion Architecture (Bronze -> Silver -> Gold) designed for real-time telemetry streaming and daily batch aggregations using PySpark, Delta Lake, and Automated Data Quality rules.
businessProblem: Legacy data warehouse suffered from 14-hour batch processing windows, high cloud compute billing, and schema drift issues across incoming IoT streams.
architectureDiagram: Kafka / S3 Stream -> Bronze Delta (Raw Ingestion) -> Silver Delta (Cleaned & Schema Validated) -> Gold Delta (Aggregated Business Data Marts) -> Power BI / Databricks SQL
challenges: Enforcing strict schema validation without dropping unexpected incoming data records.
Optimizing Delta Lake file size compaction (OPTIMIZE & Z-ORDER) to accelerate BI query execution.
solution: Implemented Auto-Loader with schema evolution for Bronze tables, automated PySpark transformation pipelines for Silver validation, and pre-computed Gold aggregation views.
lessonsLearned: Proper Delta Lake Z-Ordering on high-cardinality join keys decreased BI query duration from minutes to under 3 seconds.
businessImpact: Cut data pipeline execution window from 14 hours to 45 minutes; reduced AWS infrastructure spending by 42%.
futureImprovements: Migrating Apache Airflow DAGs to Databricks Workflows with Delta Live Tables (DLT).

title: AWS Cloud Security & Multi-Account Governance Platform
tagline: Automated Security Compliance, IAM Guardrails & CloudTrail Audit System
executiveSummary: Comprehensive AWS cloud architecture blueprint enforcing CIS AWS Benchmarks, GuardDuty anomaly detection, KMS encryption, and automated compliance remediation via AWS Lambda & CloudWatch.
businessProblem: Unmonitored AWS resource provisionings across multiple developer accounts led to security vulnerability exposures and compliance audit failures.
architectureDiagram: AWS Control Tower -> AWS Config Rules -> CloudTrail Audit Stream -> GuardDuty EventBridge -> Lambda Auto-Remediation -> Security Hub Alerting
challenges: Automating non-compliant S3 bucket policy remediations without breaking active application integrations.
Structuring least-privilege IAM roles for dynamic CI/CD deployment pipelines.
solution: Built automated Terraform modules deploying centralized AWS Control Tower guardrails with event-driven Lambda auto-remediation scripts.
lessonsLearned: Event-driven security remediation prevents security exposure windows by acting within seconds of resource configuration drift.
businessImpact: Achieved 100% compliance score across SOC2 & CIS AWS Security benchmarks for client cloud infrastructure.
futureImprovements: Integration with HashiCorp Vault for multi-cloud secret dynamic rotation.

title: Executive Enterprise Power BI Analytics Suite
tagline: Financial, Supply Chain & Operational Intelligence Dashboards
executiveSummary: Interactive, highly optimized Power BI dashboard suite connecting to Snowflake and Azure SQL, featuring advanced DAX formulas, row-level security (RLS), and automated scheduled incremental refreshes.
businessProblem: Executive stakeholders lacked real-time visibility into cross-departmental supply chain bottlenecks and revenue variance.
architectureDiagram: Snowflake Data Warehouse -> DirectQuery / Import Data Model -> DAX Analytics Engine -> Dynamic Power BI Desktop -> RLS Security Gate -> Power BI Service Portal
challenges: Maintaining instantaneous drill-down rendering speed across a 50-million row fact table dataset.
Implementing strict role-based data visibility for regional vice presidents.
solution: Implemented Aggregation Tables in Power BI paired with dynamic DAX measures and dimensional star-schema data modeling.
lessonsLearned: Pushing heavy transformations back to Snowflake data warehouse layer dramatically improves Power BI report responsiveness.
businessImpact: Delivered executive decision-making clarity, identifying $1.2M in supply chain cost optimization opportunities.
futureImprovements: Embedding real-time Power BI reports into enterprise React web portals.
